name: Matrix Rain Clock
description: Digital rain clock for M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4 / 1280x720 DSI): 80-column glyph rain, a 7-segment clock the rain refracts through, touch WiFi setup wizard, NTP + hardware RTC timekeeping. | M5Stack Tab5 数字雨时钟：80 列字符雨、被雨折射的 7 段式时钟、全触控 WiFi 配网向导、NTP + 硬件 RTC 对时。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: v1.3.5 — power saving now knows whether the clock is on a cable or on its battery. Plugged in: no dimming, no slow-down, no blank screen, and a screen that had already gone dark wakes up again when the cable goes in. On battery: unchanged (dim after 2 min, slower after 3, backlight off after 10, one touch to restore). Also fixed: a plugged cable used to feed the clock while the battery never actually charged. Setup → About shows which source is in use. | v1.3.5 —— 省电现在分得清是插着线还是用电池。插线时：不调暗、不变慢、不熄屏，已经暗掉的屏幕插上线会自己亮回来。拔线用电池时照旧：2 分钟调暗、3 分钟变慢、10 分钟关背光，碰一下恢复。另外修好了充电——以前插着线只是给时钟供电，电池其实一直没充进去。设置菜单的 About 页能看到当前用的是哪一路。

The on-screen keyboard could not type lower-case at all: the key caps and the character inserted both came from the upper-case table, so SHFT only repainted its own key (issue #2). Keys now type lower-case by default, SHFT is a one-shot upper-case modifier, and the caps show the case they will type. The password field is no longer masked, so the case is checkable before Connect.

Backlight brightness via LEDC PWM (GPIO22); unified green-on-black setup menu (WiFi / character set / brightness / About); non-ASCII SSID placeholders instead of blanks; fixed the blue-screen crash and screen residue when leaving the setup menu.
